days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Skeggi
stops.detail: Its highest peak, Skeggi, rises 803 m above the sea.

stops.name: Innstidalur
stops.detail: For instance, one of the most productive steam springs in the country is located in Innstidalur between Hengill and Skarðsmýrarfjall.

stops.name: Sleggja
stops.detail: In a secondary peak, the Sleggja, rhyolite is also found.

days.title: Geothermal Power and Lava Fields
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nesjavellir
stops.detail: Furthermore, the origin of the lava fields near Nesjavellir, the so-called Nesjahraun, is located here.

stops.name: Hellisheiði-Kraftwerk
stops.detail: In addition, another even larger power plant was built on the Hellisheiði, the Hellisheiði Power Plant, which also utilizes the substantial energy source of Hengill.

stops.name: Tjarnarhnjúkur
stops.detail: Hrómundartindur, with its high-temperature area under the Tjarnarhnjúkur volcano and at Ölkelduháls, lies to the northeast of it on the Hellisheiði.

stops.name: Hveragerði
stops.detail: The small town of Hveragerði with its hot springs is located about 10 km east of Hengill in the area of the Grensdalur volcano.
